caption: A spoonful of matcha powder is stirred into a glass of milk, and the milk turns pale green.

sa.check: A glass of milk is present.
The stir comes first and the colour follows.

pc.expect: The pale green spreads from the spoon through the milk in swirls from the spoon, evening out and never gathers back; coloured areas stay coloured.
pc.fail: The milk returns to its original colour where it was pale green; or the pale green gathers back into the spoon; or the pale green appears before the spoon arrives.

pc.expect: The result is pale green, and un-reached milk keeps its original colour.
pc.fail: The milk turns a colour other than pale green; or the un-reached milk changes; or the pale green is darker than the spoon itself.

pc.expect: The milk behaves as it should: streaks and swirls where stirred or spread, settling where it flows.
pc.fail: The milk is rigid and unmarked; or it flows like water when it is a paste; or it bounces like rubber.

pc.expect: The milk moves only where stirred or where the pale green flows.
pc.fail: The milk swirls by itself; or the pale green spreads faster than stirring or flow carries it; or the container moves.

pc.expect: The amount of milk stays the same and the container keeps its shape.
pc.fail: The container fills or empties on its own; or a second container appears; or the spoon passes through the container.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The container and the background stay the same.
pc.fail: The container changes colour; or the background rearranges; or the tool changes.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
